activity.notes: ATLAS uses 1432 as van Eyck's representative Burgundian artistic milestone year. He was in the service of Philip the Good, Duke of Burgundy, and by May 1432 had completed the Ghent Altarpiece left unfinished by his brother Hubert.

sources.title: Jan van Eyck — National Gallery, London
sources.citation_text: The National Gallery records Jan van Eyck's service to Philip the Good, Duke of Burgundy, and completion of the Ghent Altarpiece before 6 May 1432.
